pick.headline: US and China establish diplomatic relations
pick.summary: On 1 January 1979 the United States and the People's Republic of China formally established diplomatic relations, and Washington ended official relations with Taiwan.
pick.significance: Normalization completed the opening begun by Nixon and aligned Washington and Beijing against Moscow. Soviet media treated it as an anti-Soviet combination.

alternates.headline: Czechoslovakia splits into two states
alternates.summary: At midnight on 1 January 1993 Czechoslovakia ceased to exist, peacefully dividing into the Czech Republic and Slovakia.
alternates.significance: The 'Velvet Divorce' was a rare negotiated break-up of a state, in sharp contrast to Yugoslavia's wars. It redrew Central Europe a little over three years after the fall of communism.

alternates.headline: Zapatista rebels seize towns in Chiapas
alternates.summary: On 1 January 1994, the day NAFTA took effect, the Zapatista National Liberation Army seized San Cristobal de las Casas and other towns in the Mexican state of Chiapas.
alternates.significance: The rising was timed to the start of the North American Free Trade Agreement and put Mexico's indigenous south and its ruling party under international scrutiny. It opened a year of crisis for Mexico, Washington's new free-trade partner.
